## Parent

turnkey-vnm

## What to build

The on-demand server runs with an idle timeout (e.g. 24h) and exits by itself. The next `tk test` starts it again (spec §6).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The server exits after the configured idle period with no traffic
- [ ] The next `tk test` restarts it transparently, and earlier recorded results are still hits

## Blocked by

- turnkey-vnm.7
title: Test result cache server shuts down when idle
